title: WarehouseLineageRecord
description: Schema for a first-class Warehouse lineage record. Every canonical artifact must carry or reference a lineage record. Status: candidate v0.1 authority: provisional.

artifact_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this artifact instance. Use a UUID or a scoped slug.

artifact_type.description: The artifact family this record belongs to.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this artifact was created.

created_by.description: Identity of the creator: a human username, agent name, or system identifier.

authority_source.description: Canonical path or URI of the authoritative source for this artifact. Must not be a reflection or mirror.

version.description: Semantic version string for this artifact.

hash.description: Content hash (SHA-256 hex) of the artifact at creation time. Used for integrity verification.

derived_from.description: List of artifact IDs that this artifact was derived from or depends on.

supersedes.description: Artifact ID of the prior version this artifact replaces, if any.

superseded_by.description: Artifact ID of the newer version that replaces this artifact, if any. Null if current.

reflection_sources.description: Paths or IDs of reflection/mirror copies of this artifact. These are recovery surfaces, not authority.

session_ref.description: Reference to the session or context in which this artifact was produced.

notes.description: Free-text notes about provenance, context, or known ambiguities.
